## About
Discount Mobile Auto Glass is a windshield repair and replacement shop on E Bird Rd in Pasadena. We work on windshields, car door glass, side glass, back glass and sunroofs, and we serve drivers in Pasadena, Pearland, Deer Park, Baytown, La Porte and across the Houston area.
If you can't get away from work or home, we can send a mobile crew to you. If you're not sure whether that chip needs a repair or a whole new windshield, we'll take a look and tell you straight. Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating from 327 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours.

## Services
- Mobile windshield replacement: Stuck at home or at work with a damaged windshield? Our crew comes to you so you don't have to change your day around.
- Windshield repair: We fix chips, cracks, leaks and scratches, and we can also take care of the molding around your glass.
- Windshield replacement: When a repair won't do it, we replace the whole windshield, whatever kind of vehicle you drive.
- Car door glass and window regulators: Broken car window or a regulator that quit working? We repair and replace all types of door glass.
- Side glass: If the side glass anywhere on your vehicle gets damaged, bring it to us and we'll take care of it.

## FAQ
Q: Can you come to me instead of me driving to the shop?
A: Yes. Our technicians can meet you at home, at work or even on the side of the road around Houston, Pasadena, La Porte, Baytown and Deer Park.

Q: How do I know if I need a repair or a new windshield?
A: Our auto glass specialists will look at the damage and tell you whether a simple repair will do or the windshield needs replacing.

Q: Is a small chip worth fixing right away?
A: It's best not to wait. A single bump in the road can spread a small chip into a large crack, which turns a quick repair into a full replacement.

Q: Can I get a quote for mobile windshield replacement?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we'll give you a free quote on mobile windshield replacement.
